SELECT id, job_name, job_group, job_class, task_type, handler_code, invoke_target, cron_expression, time_zone, misfire_policy, concurrent, job_params, payload_json, start_time, end_time, status, remark, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by FROM job
AND job_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.jobName}, '%' )
AND job_group LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.jobGroup}, '%' )
AND status = #{query.status}
ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT j.id, j.job_name, j.job_group, g.group_name AS job_group_name, j.job_class, j.task_type, j.handler_code, j.invoke_target, j.cron_expression, j.time_zone, j.misfire_policy, j.concurrent, j.job_params, j.payload_json, j.start_time, j.end_time, j.status, j.remark, j.created_at, j.updated_at, j.created_by, j.updated_by FROM job j LEFT JOIN job_group g ON g.group_code = j.job_group WHERE j.id = #{id}
